name: bidwise
description: BidWise online auction system (MERN) - convenience scripts for both apps

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
